Machine translation reviewed 2026-11-23; the Chinese original prevails. lines: paragraphs and bullets; labels: bold labels; where: Taiwan mission cities. pipeline/travelmed.py add_english attaches them; text CDC rewrites falls back to Chinese until added here.

lines.孩童和成人的免疫狀態不同、行為模式也不同，所以嬰幼兒有一些不同於成人的健康風險，: Children and adults differ in immune status and behaviour, so infants and young children face some health risks that adults do not. If you plan to travel abroad with an infant or young child, especially to a developing country, we recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic early.
lines.嬰幼兒使用藥物有些特別限制，有些藥品有使用年齡下限、有些則需減少使用量，使用任何: There are special restrictions on medicines for infants and young children: some medicines have a minimum age, and others need a reduced dose. Before using any medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist, or read the package leaflet carefully.
lines.嬰幼兒是腸胃道傳染病高風險群，感染腸胃道疾病也比較容造成脫水，除了旅途中特別留意: Infants and young children are at high risk of gastrointestinal infections and become dehydrated more easily. Take particular care with the child's food and drink safety, and use drinking water to wash hands and to rinse pacifiers, feeding bottles and comfort toys. Parents are also recommended to bring oral rehydration solution (ORS) powder in case it is needed.
lines.一般而言，第二孕期間(18~24週)，孕婦狀況較穩定、較適合出國，其餘孕期則建議: In general, the second trimester (weeks 18–24) is when a pregnant woman's condition is more stable and she is better suited to travel abroad; we recommend postponing travel plans during the other stages of pregnancy. Pregnant women are recommended to discuss their travel plans with their regular obstetrician before departure and to confirm that they meet the airline's fitness-to-fly requirements.
lines.有些疾病(如瘧疾、德國麻疹)會在孕婦身上造成特別嚴重的症狀，甚至導致死胎、畸胎，: Some diseases (such as malaria and rubella) can cause especially severe illness in pregnant women, and may even lead to stillbirth or birth defects. If there is an outbreak in the destination and no suitable, effective preventive measures are available, we recommend postponing or changing the trip.
lines.孕婦在預防接種、用藥上有較多的禁忌，前往旅遊醫學門診時，請告知醫師目前的懷孕狀況: Pregnancy brings more contraindications for vaccination and medicines. When you visit a travel medicine clinic, tell the doctor about your current pregnancy so that the risk can be assessed correctly.
lines.慢性病患者應在出發前確定目前健康狀態穩定，疾病受到良好控制，以免旅遊造成健康狀況: People with chronic illness should make sure before departure that their health is currently stable and their condition is well controlled, so that travel does not make it worse. Before departure, we recommend asking your regular doctor for an English summary of your medical record and medication history. As well as serving as proof for the medicines you carry, it will help local doctors understand your condition and medication use if you need urgent medical care abroad.
lines.糖尿病患者如果旅行國家與臺灣時差超過3小時，可和醫師討論如何調整藥物使用劑量及時: If a person with diabetes travels to a country with a time difference of more than 3 hours from Taiwan, they can discuss with their doctor how to adjust the dose and timing of medicines. Those who inject insulin should pay attention to storage temperature; if the local temperature goes beyond the storage temperature range recommended for the medicine, we recommend carrying suitable anti-freezing or cooling equipment.
lines.有些藥物會和瘧疾預防用藥、高山症預防藥物產生交互作用，如您目前有服用其他藥物，請: Some medicines interact with malaria prevention medicine or altitude sickness prevention medicine. If you are taking other medicines at present, tell your doctor.
lines.平常有固定服用藥物者，應攜帶足量藥物(並多帶2~3天份)，最好能準備2倍份量藥物: People who regularly take medicines should carry enough (plus 2–3 days' extra), ideally twice the amount needed, stored separately in carry-on and checked baggage (insulin is not recommended for checked baggage) in case baggage is lost. People with a continuous prescription for chronic illness who go abroad for more than 1 month can collect the next month's medicines in advance by showing documents such as their air ticket.
lines.不論因為生病、治療或服藥造成免疫力不全，患者都應在旅遊前確定目前疾病受到穩定控制: Whether weak immunity is caused by illness, treatment or medicines, patients should make sure before travelling that their condition is currently under stable control, and we recommend first discussing the travel plan with their regular doctor.
lines.免疫力不全者感染傳染病的風險較高，也較容易出現嚴重症狀，出發前應格外留意當地是否: People with weakened immunity are at higher risk of infectious diseases and more likely to develop severe symptoms. Before departure, take extra care to check whether there is any special outbreak at the destination; if you plan to go to a developing country, we strongly recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic first. During the trip, take suitable measures against infectious diseases, such as preventing insect bites and paying attention to food and drink safety.
lines.免疫力低下者接種疫苗有些限制，有些活性疫苗則禁止接種，諮詢旅遊醫學門診時，應告知: People with weakened immunity face some restrictions on vaccination, and some live vaccines must not be given. When consulting a travel medicine clinic, tell the doctor about your current health condition, and you may consider providing your most recent blood test report. If you do not wish to disclose your medical history, we recommend consulting your regular doctor first. Some medicines interact with malaria prevention medicine or altitude sickness prevention medicine. If you are taking other medicines at present, tell your doctor.
lines.平常有固定服用藥物者，應攜帶足量藥物(並多帶2~3天份)，最好能準備2倍份量藥物: People who regularly take medicines should carry enough (plus 2–3 days' extra), ideally twice the amount needed, stored separately in carry-on and checked baggage in case baggage is lost. People with a continuous prescription for chronic illness who go abroad for more than 1 month can collect the next month's medicines in advance by showing documents such as their air ticket.
lines.因旅客為在當地停留的時間，較一般觀光、短期商務行程更長，傳染病風險也隨之增加，行: Because travellers stay at the destination longer than on ordinary tourist or short business trips, the risk of infectious diseases also increases. Before departure, be sure to review the local infectious disease risks and prevention advice, and we recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic early.
lines.除非熟悉當地就醫流程及醫療體系，否則建議出發前提早至少1個月進行基本健康檢查(含: Unless you are familiar with the local medical procedures and health care system, we recommend having a basic health check-up (including a dental check) at least 1 month before departure. If you take medicines regularly, we recommend carrying enough, as far as the shelf life of the medicines allows.
lines.部份國家針對就學、就業等長期居留旅客有額外規定，除非國內無法取得疫苗或無法提供相: Some countries have extra requirements for long-term residents such as students and workers. Unless the vaccine is unavailable in Taiwan, the relevant testing services cannot be provided, or the destination requires the check to be done after entry, we recommend completing them in Taiwan first.
lines.海外志工、救援工作者所暴露的健康風險和一般旅客完全不同，風險型態也會隨著在當地從: The health risks faced by overseas volunteers and relief workers are completely different from those of ordinary travellers. The type of risk varies greatly with the work done there, the extent of the disaster and the type of disaster, but in general the risk is higher than for other travellers.
lines.因當地醫療資源可能較為缺乏，孕婦、有較嚴重潛在健康問題等很可能需要醫療照護者，不: Because local medical resources may be scarce, travel is not recommended for pregnant women and for people with more serious underlying health problems who are likely to need medical care.
lines.務必提早諮詢旅遊醫學門診，並務必確認完成所有的常規預防接種。從事臨床醫療相關工作: Be sure to consult a travel medicine clinic early, and be sure to confirm that all routine vaccinations are complete. Those working in clinical care should, before departure, seek advice on occupational exposure risks and discuss with a doctor whether extra measures to prevent infectious diseases are needed.
lines.如果接到出勤通知和實際出發日常常間隔不滿1週者，建議平時先完成較通用性的預防接種: If the interval between the deployment notice and the actual departure date is often less than 1 week, we recommend completing the more widely useful vaccinations in advance (such as the tetanus vaccine and hepatitis A vaccine). Because protection lasts a long time after yellow fever vaccination, those who are highly likely to be deployed to places such as Africa and South America may consider being assessed for vaccination.
lines.每個國家的健康風險都不太一樣，出發前請先充份了解當地的旅遊安全概況，做好相關行前: Health risks differ from country to country. Before departure, first get a full understanding of the local travel safety situation and make the relevant preparations:
lines.了解當地旅遊安全及傳染病風險概況: Learn about local travel safety and infectious disease risks
lines.請參考本署網站提供的傳染病資訊及預防建議，其他旅遊安全資訊請參考外交部領事事務局: Please refer to the infectious disease information and prevention advice on the Taiwan CDC website; for other travel safety information, please refer to the "Overseas Safety Information" section of the website of the Bureau of Consular Affairs (BOCA), Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Because local conditions can change at any time, before departure be sure to check again the latest "Travel Health Notice level" and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' "Overseas Travel Alert levels".
lines.接種疫苗、準備預防藥物: Get vaccinated and prepare preventive medicines
lines.請檢視本次旅行是否需要接種疫苗、使用瘧疾預防藥物，詳細資訊請參閱下方「預防接種規: Please check whether this trip requires vaccination or malaria prevention medicine. For details, see the section "Vaccination requirements and recommendations" below.
lines.除了一般旅遊必備物品，旅客應打造專屬的「旅遊健康包」，建議隨身攜帶口罩、乾洗手液: Besides the usual travel essentials, travellers should put together their own "travel health kit". We recommend carrying personal hygiene items such as masks, hand sanitiser and wet wipes, and you may bring a suitable amount of commonly used over-the-counter medicines and wound care supplies. If there is a special infectious disease risk at the destination, also prepare extra protective items such as insect repellent and treatment medicines as needed.
lines.海外就醫費用多半十分高昂，請視個人需求額外投保旅遊醫療保險。: Medical costs abroad are mostly very high. Take out additional travel medical insurance according to your own needs.
lines.自助旅行或預計長期停留當地的旅客，建議先查詢當地的就醫資訊。: Travellers on independent trips, or planning to stay at the destination for a long time, are recommended to look up local medical information first.
lines.大部分疫苗接種後需要2週才會產生足夠保護力，有些疫苗需要間隔一段時間再接種第2劑: Most vaccines take 2 weeks after vaccination to give enough protection, and some vaccines need a second or even third dose after an interval. Malaria prevention medicine also has to be started before arriving in the affected area. We recommend that travellers visit a travel medicine clinic 2 to 4 weeks before departure to get the doctor's advice.
lines.很多傳染病沒有有效的疫苗或預防藥物，旅途中應採取以下預防措施：: Many infectious diseases have no effective vaccine or preventive medicine. During the trip, take the following preventive measures:
lines.(疾病流行情況可能隨時改變，以下僅舉幾項重要疾病，其他近期資訊請參考「即時疫情」: (The outbreak situation of diseases may change at any time. Only a few important diseases are listed below; for other recent information, please refer to "Real-time outbreak")
lines.保持個人衛生是預防傳染病的共通原則。建議旅途中常以肥皂(或乾洗手液)洗手，尤其是: Keeping up personal hygiene is the common principle for preventing infectious diseases. During the trip, we recommend washing your hands often with soap (or hand sanitiser), especially before meals and after using the toilet, and touching your eyes, nose and mouth as little as possible. If you need to stay for a long time in a crowded, poorly ventilated indoor space, you may consider wearing a mask.
lines.注意飲食安全: Take care with food and drink safety
lines.當地雖然公共衛生條件水準較高，但仍有發生食物中毒風險，建議旅客盡量熟食、熱食，水: Although local public health standards are high, there is still a risk of food poisoning. Travellers are recommended to eat cooked and hot food as far as possible, wash fruit themselves or peel it before eating, and keep an eye on local food poisoning news.
lines.在當地應避免逗弄、餵食哺乳動物，並避免至可能有蝙蝠的洞窟，以免感染狂犬病。: Do not tease or feed mammals, and stay out of caves that may house bats, to avoid rabies.
lines.疑似傳染病症狀處理: What to do with suspected infectious disease symptoms
lines.發燒是很多傳染病的初期症狀，一般感染所引起的發燒可在48小時內緩解，如果體溫持續: Fever is an early symptom of many infectious diseases. A fever caused by an ordinary infection usually eases within 48 hours. If the body temperature keeps rising, there is a high fever (above 39 degrees), it comes with other symptoms such as a skin rash, a stiff neck or confusion, or there is a special alert for an outbreak at the destination, seek medical care immediately.
lines.出現腹瀉症狀時，最重要的是補充足量水分，避免飲用咖啡、酒、含高糖分飲料等容易加速: When you have diarrhoea, the most important thing is to drink enough fluids. Avoid drinks that speed up dehydration, such as coffee, alcohol and drinks high in sugar, and in general do not take anti-diarrhoea medicine on your own. Most diarrhoea gets better by itself, but if you show signs of dehydration (dry mouth, sunken eyes, dry skin that has lost its elasticity), blood in the stool, very severe diarrhoea and vomiting, or no improvement after 3 days or more, seek medical care immediately.
lines.當地的哺乳類動物(含蝙蝠)可能帶有狂犬病病毒，如遭哺乳動物抓咬受傷、或遭舔舐有傷: Mammals there (including bats) may carry the rabies virus. If a mammal scratches or bites you, or licks broken skin, immediately rinse with plenty of soapy water for 15 minutes, and seek medical care straight away to get the rabies vaccine and immunoglobulin. If you have not had a tetanus vaccine within the past 5 years, we recommend having the tetanus vaccine at the same time.
lines.急難救助求救管道: Where to call for emergency help
lines.如遭逢急難事故，可請國內親友協助撥打免付費「旅外國人緊急服務專線」0800-08: In an emergency, you can ask relatives and friends in Taiwan to call the toll-free "Emergency Service Hotline for Taiwanese Travelling Abroad" 0800-085-095 (a homophone for "you help me, you save me"). Calling Taiwan from abroad, you pay the international call charges yourself. Dial: (international call prefix of the country you are in)+886-800-085-095.
lines.疑似傳染病旅客返國時主動通報: Travellers with suspected infectious disease should report voluntarily on returning
lines.旅途中或返國途中如果有任何不適症狀，入境時您可諮詢疾病管制署機場檢疫櫃台，檢疫人: If you have any symptoms of illness during the trip or on the way home, you can consult the Taiwan CDC airport quarantine counter on entry, and the quarantine staff will give you suitable information and handling to protect the health of you and your family and friends. If there is a special outbreak at the destination, be sure to make a voluntary report on entry as required.
lines.旅遊後21天內如有不適，建議就醫評估，並告知醫師相關旅遊史，以利醫師作出正確的診: If you feel unwell within 21 days after travel, we recommend seeing a doctor for assessment and telling the doctor about your travel history, so that the doctor can make a correct diagnosis. If you have respiratory symptoms such as cough or sore throat, we recommend wearing a mask.
lines.有任何疑問，可撥打疾病管制署免付費諮詢專線1922或0800-001922洽詢(: If you have any questions, you can call the Taiwan CDC toll-free hotline 1922 or 0800-001922 (from abroad, call +886-800-001922; the caller pays the international call charges).
lines.不論是否出國，都應該完成常規疫苗的施打，出發前請確認已按時完成接種。有些例行性疫: Whether or not you travel abroad, you should complete your routine vaccinations; before departure, make sure they have been completed on schedule. Some diseases prevented by routine vaccines are now rare in Taiwan but are still found in other countries. Travellers who have not completed their vaccinations, or are unsure of their vaccination history, are recommended to consult a travel medicine clinic doctor before departure and to catch up on vaccines as needed.
lines.幼兒在出發前，應該依年齡完成應注射的常規疫苗，假如要前往開發中國家或高風險國家，: Before departure, young children should complete the routine vaccines due for their age. If they are going to a developing country or high-risk country and are not yet old enough to be vaccinated, you can ask a doctor whether vaccination can be given earlier or the interval between doses shortened.
lines.年滿6個月以上、未滿1歲的嬰兒，如果要前往麻疹疫區，建議自費接種1劑麻疹、德國麻: Infants aged 6 months or more but under 1 year who are going to a measles-affected area are recommended to have 1 dose of the combined measles, rubella and mumps vaccine at their own expense. For information on self-paid vaccination, contact your local health bureau, health centre or travel medicine clinic.
lines.免疫不全者建議評估接種肺炎鏈球菌疫苗，並每年接種流感疫苗，不符公費接種條件者可考: People with weakened immunity are recommended to be assessed for the pneumococcal vaccine and to have the influenza vaccine every year. Those who do not meet the conditions for the publicly funded vaccine may consider vaccination at their own expense.
lines.造血幹細胞(如骨髓)移植者需在移植後，重新評估接種所有常規疫苗，出國前請確認已完: People who have had a haematopoietic stem cell (such as bone marrow) transplant need to be reassessed for all routine vaccines after the transplant; before going abroad, make sure vaccination has been completed.
lines.慢性疾病患者是流感重症的高危險族群，建議每年接種流感疫苗，另建議接種肺炎鏈球菌疫: People with chronic illness are at high risk of severe influenza, so the influenza vaccine every year is recommended, and the pneumococcal vaccine is also recommended. Those who do not meet the conditions for the publicly funded vaccine may consider vaccination at their own expense.
lines.依據世界衛生組織「國際旅遊與健康—國家與地區疫苗預防接種建議列表」，該國未針對入: According to the World Health Organization (WHO) "International travel and health: vaccination requirements and recommendations by country" list, this country does not require vaccination from people entering.
lines.未滿9個月嬰兒不建議接種黃熱病疫苗，建議暫緩前往高風險國家。: The yellow fever vaccine is not recommended for infants under 9 months; we recommend postponing travel to high-risk countries.
lines.懷孕初期不建議接種黃熱病疫苗；於其他孕期間，除非經醫師評估有接種的必要性，也不建: The yellow fever vaccine is not recommended in early pregnancy; in other stages of pregnancy it is also not recommended unless a doctor assesses that vaccination is necessary, and pregnant women are recommended to postpone travel to high-risk areas as far as possible. If you must go, be sure to take extra measures against mosquito bites. If you are assessed as unsuitable for vaccination but the local government requires entering travellers to show a vaccination certificate, a doctor can issue a "certificate of unsuitability for vaccination", but the local health authority may still take the necessary quarantine measures as it sees fit.
lines.黃熱病疫苗為活性疫苗，免疫不全症患者可能不適合接種，近期內曾使用免疫抑制劑、放射: The yellow fever vaccine is a live vaccine and may not be suitable for people with immunodeficiency. People who have recently used immunosuppressants or had radiotherapy can be vaccinated only after an interval following the end of treatment. Consult a travel medicine clinic early.
lines.如果經評估不適合接種疫苗，建議暫緩前往高風險區；如必須前往，請務必採取加強性的防: If you are assessed as unsuitable for vaccination, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas. If you must go, be sure to take extra measures against mosquito bites. If the local government requires entering travellers to show a vaccination certificate, a doctor can issue a "certificate of unsuitability for vaccination", but the local health authority may still take the necessary quarantine measures as it sees fit.
lines.境內無感染風險，無特別預防接種之建議。: There is no risk of infection within the country, and no special vaccination is recommended.
lines.衛生條件良好的國家偶爾也有A型肝炎流行疫情，如果會前往鄉村等飲食衛生疑慮較高地區: Countries with good hygiene also occasionally have hepatitis A outbreaks. If you will visit rural or other areas with greater concerns about food and drink hygiene, or there has recently been an outbreak report there, we recommend asking a doctor before departure whether vaccination is needed.
lines.1歲以下嬰兒目前沒有足夠的安全性、疫苗有效性資料，不適合接種A型肝炎疫苗。: There are currently not enough data on safety and vaccine effectiveness for infants under 1 year, so the hepatitis A vaccine is not suitable for them.
lines.孕婦沒有足夠的接種試驗資料，雖然不活化疫苗對胎兒理論上沒有影響，仍應由醫師評估，: There are not enough vaccination trial data for pregnant women. Although an inactivated vaccine should in theory have no effect on the baby, a doctor should still assess it, and vaccination is recommended only if necessary.
lines.建議免疫不全者接種A型肝炎疫苗。: People with weakened immunity are recommended to have the hepatitis A vaccine.
lines.當地曾在蝙蝠發現狂犬病病毒，其他動物則尚無感染報告，依據衛生福利部傳染病防治諮詢: Rabies virus has been found in bats there, while no infection has been reported in other animals. According to the 1st meeting of 2026 (ROC year 115) of the Vaccination Group of the Advisory Committee on Communicable Disease Control (ACIP), Ministry of Health and Welfare, the recommendations for rabies pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) for travellers at risk of exposure to rabid animals or with difficulty obtaining safe post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), with an exposure period of ≦3 years, are as follows:
lines.免疫力正常者接種2劑次(接種時程為第0、7天)。: People with normal immunity: 2 doses (schedule: days 0 and 7).
lines.免疫力低下者接種3劑次(接種時程為第0、7、21或28天)。: People with weakened immunity: 3 doses (schedule: days 0, 7, and 21 or 28).
lines.建議旅客至少提早1個月至旅醫門診諮詢，並請醫師評估是否需要接種暴露前疫苗。: Travellers are recommended to consult a travel medicine clinic at least 1 month in advance and to have the doctor assess whether pre-exposure vaccination is needed.
lines.幼兒較容易受到動物攻擊，若預計在當地長期停留，且當地犬、貓有狂犬病疫情，可考慮先: Young children are more easily attacked by animals. If they plan to stay there long-term and dogs and cats there have rabies outbreaks, you may consider giving 3 doses of rabies vaccine first.
lines.預防麻疹與德國麻疹最有效的方式為接種MMR疫苗，目前國內提供滿1歲及滿5歲的幼兒: The most effective way to prevent measles and rubella is the MMR vaccine. Taiwan currently provides one publicly funded dose of MMR vaccine to children at age 1 and age 5. Women aged 15 to 49 of childbearing age who test negative for rubella antibodies can show the negative rubella antibody report and receive one publicly funded dose of MMR vaccine at a local health centre or a contracted vaccination clinic. Other people who are adults born in 1966 or later and plan to go to an affected area are recommended to first contact a travel medicine clinic or a medical institution in Taiwan that offers self-paid MMR vaccine, to be assessed for one dose of MMR vaccine.
lines.孕婦及未滿1歲的嬰幼兒是感染高危險群，應避免前往流行地區；如必須前往,6個月以上: Pregnant women and infants and young children under 1 year are at high risk of infection and should avoid travelling to affected areas. If they must go, infants and young children aged 6 months or more but under 1 year can have one dose of MMR vaccine at their own expense at least 2 weeks before departure.
lines.孕婦不可接種MMR疫苗，如須前往流行地區，出發前請先與醫師諮詢確認有無德國麻疹抗: Pregnant women must not have the MMR vaccine. If a pregnant woman must travel to an affected area, before departure she should consult a doctor to confirm whether she has rubella antibodies and whether it is suitable for her to go. While there, be sure to wear a mask and wash your hands often to lower the risk of infection.
lines.戶外活動時，穿著淺色長袖衣褲、包鞋及長襪，儘量減少裸露部位。: Outdoors, wear light-coloured long sleeves and trousers, closed shoes and socks, and keep as little skin exposed as possible.
lines.使用政府機關核可含DEET(敵避)、Picaridin(派卡瑞丁)或IR-353: Use repellent approved by government authorities that contains an effective ingredient such as DEET, Picaridin or IR-3535 (for children, products with a concentration of 15% or less are recommended).
lines.在裸露部位使用防蚊劑，避免沾到眼、鼻等黏膜部位。: Apply repellent to exposed skin, and avoid getting it on mucous membranes such as the eyes and nose.
lines.依照包裝說明按時補擦，如果流汗或遇水，應增加補擦的次數。: Reapply on time according to the package instructions, and reapply more often if you sweat or get wet.
lines.同時使用防曬油、防蚊劑，應先擦防曬，間隔15分鐘再使用防蚊劑。: If you use both sunscreen and repellent, apply sunscreen first and wait 15 minutes before applying repellent.
lines.環境用防蚊液只能噴在衣物及物品(如紗窗、帳篷)上，不能用於人體。: Environmental repellent spray can only be sprayed on clothing and objects (such as window screens and tents), and must not be used on the body.
lines.選擇有空調、紗窗的旅館，或懸掛蚊帳(確認無破洞)，必要時噴灑環境用殺蟲或防蚊劑。: Choose accommodation with air conditioning or window screens, or sleep under a mosquito net without holes; spray insecticide or repellent in the room if needed.
lines.中東呼吸道冠狀病毒可能會透過駱駝傳染，在當地應避免接觸或騎乘駱駝、生飲駝奶。: MERS coronavirus can spread through camels: avoid touching or riding camels and drinking raw camel milk.
lines.在國外遭逢急難事故，請先聯絡當地駐外館處急難救助專線。: If you meet with an emergency abroad, first contact the emergency assistance hotline of Taiwan's overseas mission there.
lines.如無法與駐外單位取得聯繫，可請國內親友協助撥打免付費「旅外國人緊急服務專線」08: If you cannot reach Taiwan's overseas mission, you can ask relatives and friends in Taiwan to call the toll-free "Emergency Service Hotline for Taiwanese Travelling Abroad" 0800-085-095 (a homophone for "you help me, you save me"). Calling Taiwan from abroad, you pay the international call charges yourself. Dial: (international call prefix of the country you are in)+886-800-085-095.
lines.依據世界衛生組織「國際旅遊與健康—國家與地區疫苗預防接種建議列表」，來自高風險國: According to the World Health Organization (WHO) "International travel and health: vaccination requirements and recommendations by country" list, travellers aged 9 months or more coming from a high-risk country, or who have a layover of more than 12 hours in a high-risk country, must all show a yellow fever vaccination certificate. The certificate takes effect on day 10 after vaccination and is valid for life; certificates issued before 11 July 2016 are not subject to the 10-year validity date originally noted on them. If you expect to enter the country via another affected country, you must be vaccinated early.
lines.※由於各國政府可能依當地防疫需要，即時調整入境預防接種政策，建議於出國前先洽目的: * Because governments may adjust entry vaccination policies at short notice according to local disease control needs, we recommend checking the website of the destination country's foreign ministry or Taiwan's overseas mission before travelling to learn the latest visa application or entry document requirements.
lines.當地的飲食、飲水有傳染風險，建議旅客接種疫苗。: Food and drink there carry a risk of infection, and travellers are recommended to be vaccinated.
lines.當地蝙蝠、犬、貓等哺乳動物都可能帶有狂犬病病毒，依據衛生福利部傳染病防治諮詢會預: Mammals there such as bats, dogs and cats may all carry the rabies virus. According to the 1st meeting of 2026 (ROC year 115) of the Vaccination Group of the Advisory Committee on Communicable Disease Control (ACIP), Ministry of Health and Welfare, the recommendations for rabies pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) for travellers at risk of exposure to rabid animals or with difficulty obtaining safe post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), with an exposure period of ≦3 years, are as follows:
lines.行程中會前往較偏僻或衛生條件較差地區的旅客(如探親、志工活動、背包客)，請告知醫: Travellers whose trip takes them to remote areas or areas with poorer hygiene (such as those visiting relatives, doing volunteer work or backpacking) should tell the doctor about the itinerary and ask the doctor to assess whether vaccination is needed.
lines.2歲以下嬰幼兒目前沒有足夠的安全性、疫苗有效性資料，不適合接種傷寒疫苗。: There are currently not enough data on safety and vaccine effectiveness for infants and young children under 2 years, so the typhoid vaccine is not suitable for them.
lines.國內現用的傷寒疫苗是注射式的「多醣類不活化疫苗」，也就是「死菌疫苗」，免疫不全者: The typhoid vaccine now used in Taiwan is an injectable "polysaccharide inactivated vaccine", that is, a "killed vaccine", and people with weakened immunity can be assessed for vaccination in the same way as other travellers.
lines.不吃未煮熟的食物，如：沙拉、生海鮮、半熟肉品或蛋、含生蛋或生佐料的醬汁。: Do not eat undercooked food, such as salad, raw seafood, half-cooked meat or eggs, and sauces containing raw egg or raw seasonings.
lines.水果建議自行清洗、去皮，避免食用已去皮切片的水果。: Wash fruit yourself and peel it, and avoid fruit that has been peeled and sliced already.
lines.盡量熱食(選擇現場烹調、持續加熱或點餐後再次加熱的食物)，以免食物冷卻及保存過程: Eat hot food as far as possible (choose food cooked on the spot, kept hot, or reheated after you order), so that bacteria do not grow or flies settle on food as it cools and is stored.
lines.只飲用包裝完整的水、飲料，或確認經過煮沸的水。: Drink only water and drinks in intact sealed packaging, or water confirmed to have been boiled.
lines.避免食用冰品、或含冰塊飲料，除非確認是由乾淨的水源製成。: Avoid ice products or drinks with ice, unless you are sure they were made from a clean water source.
lines.選擇衛生條件良好的用餐地點，如規模較大的飯店、沒有蟑螂蚊蠅的餐廳。: Eat where hygiene is good, such as larger hotels and restaurants without cockroaches or flies.
lines.當地境內有瘧疾疫情，瘧疾延遲治療可能致死，如出現發燒症狀，即使有服用預防性藥物，: There is a malaria outbreak within the country, and delayed treatment of malaria can be fatal. If you develop a fever, even if you have taken preventive medicine, seek medical care immediately so that diagnosis and treatment are not delayed.
lines.當地有瘧疾疫情，曾在高風險區停留旅客，請注意以下事項：: There is a malaria outbreak there. Travellers who have stayed in high-risk areas should note the following:
lines.繼續將瘧疾預防藥物服用完畢，才能達到最佳保護效果。: Finish taking all of the malaria prevention medicine to get the best protection.
lines.瘧疾大部分在感染後的7~30天出現症狀，但潛伏期也可能長達數個月、甚至數年，返國: Most malaria symptoms appear 7–30 days after infection, but the incubation period can also be as long as several months or even years. Within 1 year after returning, if you develop suspected symptoms such as fever, seek medical care immediately and tell the doctor that you have been to a malaria-affected area. Delayed treatment can be fatal.
lines.欲前往朝覲(Hajj)的旅客都必須接種流行性腦脊髓膜炎疫苗，並出示預防接種證明書: Travellers going on the Hajj must all be vaccinated with the meningococcal vaccine and show a vaccination certificate.
lines.另在阿富汗待超過4週的旅客，離境時須提供4週以前且過去1年內接種之流行性腦脊髓膜: In addition, travellers who have stayed in Afghanistan for more than 4 weeks must, on leaving the country, provide a certificate of meningococcal vaccination given at least 4 weeks earlier and within the past year.
lines.國內現用的四價結合性疫苗，在9個月以下嬰兒沒有足夠的安全性、疫苗有效性資料，不適: For the quadrivalent conjugate vaccine now used in Taiwan, there are not enough data on safety and vaccine effectiveness for infants aged 9 months or younger, so it is not suitable for them.
lines.孕婦沒有足夠的接種試驗資料，雖然不活化疫苗對胎兒理論上沒有影響，動物試驗中也未見: There are not enough vaccination trial data for pregnant women. Although an inactivated vaccine should in theory have no effect on the baby, and animal studies have shown no harmful effect on the embryo, a doctor should still assess it, and vaccination is recommended only if necessary.
lines.世界衛生組織將當地列為「受WPV1、cVDPV1或cVDPV3感染國家，且具國際: The World Health Organization lists this country as "a country infected with WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 and at risk of international spread". If you stay in the country for more than 4 weeks, then according to WHO recommendations you should have 1 dose of polio vaccine between 4 weeks and 12 months before leaving, and the vaccination must be recorded on the International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis ("yellow card").
lines.當地目前有小兒麻痺疫情，未完成或接種史不明者，行前應提早至旅遊醫學門診補接種小兒: There is currently a polio outbreak there. People who have not completed their vaccination or whose vaccination history is unclear should visit a travel medicine clinic early before departure to catch up on the polio vaccine, and be sure to confirm that children have completed their vaccinations on schedule.
lines.5月至11月間，海拔2000公尺以下之地區有熱帶瘧及間日瘧感染風險。: From May to November, there is a risk of falciparum malaria and vivax malaria in areas below 2000 metres above sea level.
lines.建議前往前述風險區旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。: Travellers going to the above risk areas are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.
lines.幼兒感染瘧疾可能會有嚴重併發症，請務必提早諮詢醫師預防用藥相關建議，並採取適當防: Malaria in young children may cause serious complications. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine, and take suitable measures against mosquito bites.
lines.瘧疾預防用藥均需依照體重調整劑量，有些藥物有年齡或體重限制，不適合嬰幼兒使用，建: The dose of all malaria prevention medicines must be adjusted by body weight, and some medicines have age or weight limits and are not suitable for infants and young children. We recommend consulting a travel medicine clinic doctor.
lines.孕婦感染瘧疾發生嚴重併發症機率較高，可選擇的瘧疾預防藥物也比較有限，請務必提早諮: Pregnant women who get malaria are more likely to have serious complications, and the malaria prevention medicines they can choose from are also more limited. Be sure to consult a doctor early for advice on preventive medicine.
lines.如果沒有適合的藥物可使用，建議暫緩前往高風險區。: If there is no suitable medicine available, we recommend postponing travel to high-risk areas.
lines.有些瘧疾預防藥物會和HIV藥物產生交互作用，目前已知會用交互作用的藥物如下：: Some malaria prevention medicines interact with HIV medicines. The medicines currently known to interact are as follows:
lines.美爾奎寧(Apo-mefloqione)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用，: Mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; in addition, two other HIV medicines listed there may reduce the effect of this medicine.
lines.阿托奎酮與氯胍混合製劑(Malarone)：可能和所有蛋白質酶抑制劑產生交互作用: Atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone): may interact with all protease inhibitors, including six HIV medicines listed by their Taiwan brand names in the Chinese original; it may also interact with one other HIV medicine listed there.
lines.氯奎寧(Chloroquine)：可能和諾億亞產生交互作用。: Chloroquine: may interact with one HIV medicine (listed by its Taiwan brand name in the Chinese original).
lines.四環黴素(Doxycycline)：目前無已知交互作用。: Doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic): no interactions are currently known.
lines.居住於瘧疾高風險地區者，一般建議全程服用瘧疾預防藥物，如當地流行趨勢明顯，可與醫: People who live in high-risk malaria areas are generally recommended to take malaria prevention medicine throughout; if the local epidemic trend is clear, they can discuss with a doctor taking the medicine only during the epidemic season. According to current research on the medicines, long-term use of mefloquine (Apo-mefloqione), atovaquone–proguanil (Malarone) and doxycycline (a tetracycline antibiotic) does not affect how well they work, but consult a doctor first. However, long-term use of chloroquine, with a cumulative dose of 100 g (about 5 years of use in total), may cause retinal toxicity, so take particular care.
lines.因孕婦、嬰幼兒的瘧疾預防用藥選擇有限，如計劃於居留當地期間受孕，請先諮詢醫師相關: Because the choice of malaria prevention medicine for pregnant women and infants and young children is limited, if you plan to conceive while staying there, consult a doctor first about the risks and ways of prevention.
lines.登革熱、屈公病、茲卡病毒感染症: Dengue fever, Chikungunya, Zika virus infection
lines.茲卡病毒可由斑蚊叮咬傳播，一般旅客感染症狀較輕微，但孕婦感染可能導致胎兒小頭畸形: Zika is spread by Aedes mosquitoes. Most travellers have mild symptoms, but infection in pregnancy can cause microcephaly or death of the baby. Besides the measures above, pregnant women should postpone non-essential travel to areas at risk; pregnant women and those planning a pregnancy who must go should consult a doctor first and avoid mosquito bites throughout the stay.
lines.當地有感染血吸蟲的風險，請注意以下事項：: There is a risk of schistosomiasis infection there. Please note the following:
lines.避免接觸河流、湖泊、池塘等淡水水域。: Avoid contact with fresh water such as rivers, lakes and ponds.
lines.使用河水、湖水洗澡或洗衣，建議添加氯錠消毒，或在乾淨容器至少儲放2天再使用。: If you wash or do laundry with river or lake water, add chlorine tablets, or keep the water in a clean container for at least 2 days before using it.
lines.如不慎碰觸淡水，請立即用酒精和乾毛巾大力擦拭皮膚，減低感染風險。: If your skin touches fresh water, rub it hard with alcohol and a dry towel straight away to lower the risk of infection.

lines.蜱媒腦炎是一種由蜱蟲傳播的疾病，蜱蟲多活動於森林、草原等有樹木、灌木或草地的地方: Tick-borne encephalitis is spread by ticks, which live in forests, grassland and places with trees, bushes or grass: take extra care against bites when you go there.
lines.如遭蜱蟲叮咬，可以鑷子夾住蜱蟲前半部，垂直皮膚表面緩慢向上拔除，如無適當工具，建: If a tick bites you, grip its front end with tweezers and pull it slowly straight out of the skin; without proper tools, see a doctor so the mouthparts do not break off in the bite and cause infection.

lines.依據世界衛生組織「國際旅遊與健康—國家與地區疫苗預防接種建議列表」，所有年齡滿9: According to the World Health Organization (WHO) "International travel and health: vaccination requirements and recommendations by country" list, all travellers aged 9 months or more must show a yellow fever vaccination certificate. The certificate takes effect on day 10 after vaccination and is valid for life; certificates issued before 11 July 2016 are not subject to the 10-year validity date originally noted on them.
lines.當地全境有黃熱病感染風險，建議年齡滿9個月以上的旅客，行前至少提早10天接種疫苗: There is a risk of yellow fever infection throughout the country. Travellers aged 9 months or more are recommended to be vaccinated at least 10 days before departure.
lines.世界衛生組織將當地列為「受cVDPV2感染國家」，未完成或接種史不明者，建議行前: The World Health Organization lists this country as a "country infected with cVDPV2". People who have not completed their vaccination or whose vaccination history is unclear are recommended to visit a travel medicine clinic early before departure to catch up on the polio vaccine, and be sure to confirm that children have completed their vaccinations on schedule. If you stay in the country for more than 4 weeks, then according to WHO recommendations you are encouraged to have 1 dose of polio vaccine between 4 weeks and 12 months before leaving, and the vaccination must be recorded on the International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis ("yellow card").
lines.全境且全年皆有熱帶瘧(惡性瘧)感染風險。: There is a risk of falciparum (malignant) malaria throughout the country all year round.
lines.建議旅客採取防蚊措施，並請醫師評估是否需口服預防藥物。: Travellers are recommended to take measures against mosquito bites and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medicine is needed.
lines.降低人際間傳播風險：: Reduce the risk of person-to-person spread.
lines.有風險性行為者(例如：多重性伴侶、性交易服務者、於營業場所發生性行為者等)；過去: Mpox vaccination is for people who have risky sexual behaviour (for example, multiple sexual partners, sex workers, or people who have sex at commercial venues), who have had a sexually transmitted infection in the past, or whose sexual partners fall into any of the above.
lines.避免與M痘感染者接觸，避免出入可能與不特定人士密切接觸之社交活動等高風險場域，並: Avoid contact with people infected with mpox, avoid high-risk venues such as social events where you may have close contact with unspecified people, and use a condom throughout.
lines.由於確診個案精液中曾檢出病毒DNA,雖目前尚未確定是否具有傳染力，仍建議男性病患: Because viral DNA has been detected in the semen of confirmed cases, although it is not yet certain whether it is infectious, male patients are still recommended to avoid all sexual activity, or use a condom throughout, within three months after symptoms appear.
lines.降低人畜共通傳播風險：: Reduce the risk of catching infections from animals.
lines.前往M痘病毒流行地區時，避免接觸齧齒動物和靈長類動物以及生病或死亡動物，所有食物: When you go to areas where mpox virus is circulating, avoid contact with rodents, primates, and sick or dead animals, and all food must be thoroughly cooked before eating.
lines.避免接觸M痘確診個案曾接觸之哺乳類動物或寵物。: Avoid contact with mammals or pets that a confirmed mpox case has been in contact with.
lines.如有任何疑似症狀，應及時就醫，並告知旅遊史、高風險場域暴露史與接觸史。: If you have any suspicious symptoms, see a doctor promptly and tell them your travel history, high-risk exposures and contacts.
lines.登革熱、瘧疾、黃熱病、利什曼原蟲、茲卡病毒感染症、屈公病: Dengue fever, Malaria, Yellow fever, Leishmaniasis, Zika virus infection, Chikungunya

Within 1 year after returning, if you develop suspected malaria symptoms such as fever, seek medical care immediately and tell the doctor that you have been to a malaria-affected area. Delayed treatment can be fatal.
lines.建議前往以下地區、年齡滿9個月以上旅客接種疫苗：: Travellers aged 9 months or more who are going to the following areas are recommended to be vaccinated:

lines.Formosa省、Chaco省(Bermejo)、Jujuy省(Valle Gr: Formosa Province, Chaco Province (Bermejo), Jujuy Province (Valle Grande, Ledesma, Santa Bárbara, San Pedro), Salta Province (General José de San Martín, Oran, Rivadavia, Anta).
lines.非前往以上地區者，無特別預防接種之建議。: For those not going to the above areas, no special vaccination is recommended.
